name: Liquid Aperture
signature: Organic matte opens content through a controlled liquid contour.

name: Path Droplet
signature: A droplet remains physically attached to a path and carries focus between nodes.

name: Refraction Window
signature: Localized refractive lens reveals a secondary layer without distorting official marks.

name: Wave Handoff
signature: A whole approved wave asset translates across scene boundaries as a continuity device.

name: Ripple Datum
signature: Concentric restrained ripples introduce one verified datum at a time.

name: Continuous Route Trace
signature: One continuous route draws through the full sequence instead of restarting each scene.

name: Node Arrival
signature: Destination node resolves only when the traveling focus reaches it.

name: Territory Drift
signature: Abstract non-cartographic territory plane drifts under a fixed information lens.

name: Day-to-Day Handoff
signature: The final node of one day transforms into the entry anchor for the next day.

name: Route Lens
signature: A moving focus window enlarges the active destination while context remains visible.

name: Headline Mask Stack
signature: Word groups enter through independent clipping windows with clear hierarchy.

name: Baseline Travel
signature: Secondary text travels on a shared baseline while the main message remains stable.

name: Accent Strike
signature: A brand-role bar or underline tracks a key phrase without recoloring the whole sentence.

name: Scale Relay
signature: Hierarchy transfers between two statements by reciprocal scale rather than a card cut.

name: Editorial Margin Note
signature: Small contextual annotation enters from a consistent editorial margin.

name: Datum Stage
signature: One oversized verified number owns the frame while supporting context stays subordinate.

name: Metric Handoff
signature: A visual connector carries attention from one metric to the next.

name: Chart Focus Sweep
signature: A focus sweep progressively reveals only the active part of a chart.

name: Comparison Gate
signature: Before/after or A/B values share a moving divider with synchronized labels.

name: Impact Constellation
signature: Verified related metrics assemble into a spatial constellation with one active center.

name: Evidence Stack
signature: Real approved media builds as a staggered evidence stack with captions.

name: Contact Sheet Build
signature: A sequence of approved images assembles like a deliberate contact sheet and then resolves to one hero.

name: Caption Tracker
signature: Caption remains tied to the visual evidence through crop and camera movement.

name: Field Annotation
signature: Callout line and label identify a verified detail without obscuring the evidence.

name: Slow Evidence Push
signature: Subtle push-in and crop shift adds cinematic energy to real media while preserving authenticity.

name: Traveling Matte
signature: A geometric or organic matte travels across frame and carries a shared edge into the next scene.

name: Split Aperture
signature: Two planes separate to expose the next scene with asymmetric timing.

name: Match Shape
signature: A shared shape persists between scenes and changes semantic role.

name: Depth Occlusion
signature: Foreground plane crosses camera to conceal a scene change and reveal a new depth stack.

name: Editorial Cut
signature: A fast hard cut is softened by one persistent typographic or geometric anchor.

name: Three-Plane Parallax
signature: Foreground, content and background planes move at different controlled rates.

name: Focus Tunnel
signature: Successive frames create depth toward a single factual or conceptual focal point.

name: Layer Peel
signature: A surface layer peels away to reveal process or evidence beneath.

name: Network Build
signature: Nodes and connectors appear according to dependency order, not all at once.

name: Flow Pulse
signature: A controlled pulse travels through an existing network to explain direction and state.

name: Section Scanner
signature: A scanning window reveals one system section and its annotation at a time.

name: Safe-Area Guide
signature: Development-only overlay visualizes active Design System safe areas and is disabled for export.

name: Overflow Sentinel
signature: Development-only detector flags text or media crossing the configured safe area.

name: Contrast Sentinel
signature: Development-only checker reports low-contrast live text over dynamic surfaces.
